_설명: tools/gen_art.py가 읽는 프롬프트 모음. 영어 프롬프트가 이미지 모델에서 더 안정적이라 프롬프트는 영어, 설명은 한국어로 쓴다. 바꾸면 WORKLOG에 이유를 남긴다. 여우가 아닌 캐릭터는 art/ref/fox.png를 그림체 참고로 함께 넣는다. based_on이 있으면 그 캐릭터 그림을 넣고 그대로 고쳐 그리게 한다. 자세는 컷아웃으로 자르기 쉽게: 팔다리·꼬리가 몸통과 많이 겹치지 않게.
style: Cute 2D cartoon game sprite for a cozy forest lane-defense game. Chibi proportions (big head, small body), thick dark-brown outline (#4A3220) of even width, soft two-tone cel shading, bright warm forest palette, clean flat colors, no texture noise, no text, no ground shadow, no background scenery.
background: Fully transparent background (PNG with alpha). If transparency is impossible, use a perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF background with no gradient, no vignette and no shadow.

fox.name: 여우
fox.description: A white fox, the hero shooter of the forest. Sitting upright in side 3/4 view facing RIGHT. Pure white fur with light-gray shading, cream-colored chest, cheeks and muzzle, pink inner ears, light-gray ear tips, a big fluffy white tail curling behind with a cream tip, shiny black eyes with a white highlight, small black nose, gentle confident smile. Front paws slightly raised, ready to toss a small warm orange-gold fox-fire flame.

squirrel.name: 다람쥐
squirrel.description: A chubby orange-brown squirrel, the acorn producer. Sitting upright in side 3/4 view facing RIGHT. Warm orange-brown fur, cream belly and muzzle, round cheeks, small rounded ears with cream insides, shiny black eyes with a white highlight, tiny pink nose, happy smile. Both front paws hold one big glossy acorn against the chest. A huge fluffy curly tail rises tall behind the back in an S-shape, clearly separated from the body except at its base. Short hind legs and feet visible.

turtle.name: 거북이
turtle.description: A sturdy friendly turtle, the wall that blocks monsters. Side view facing RIGHT, standing on four short stubby legs. A big high dome shell, moss-green with lighter hexagon plates and a cream rim, takes most of the body. Light-green head stuck out to the right on a short neck, determined but kind eyes with a white highlight, small smile. Tiny pointed tail at the back. Legs and head clearly separated from the shell outline.

skunk.name: 스컨크
skunk.description: A mischievous black-and-white skunk, the bomb. Side view facing RIGHT, standing on four short legs. Black fur with a bold white stripe from the forehead along the back, white chest tuft, pink inner ears, big sparkly eyes, cheeky grin. A huge fluffy tail raised high and curling forward over the back, black with a white stripe, clearly separated from the body except at its base.

slime.name: 슬라임
slime.description: A round jelly-green slime blob monster, cute not scary. Side 3/4 view facing LEFT (its face is on the left side). Glossy translucent-looking green body shaped like a soft dome with a slightly wider bottom that sits flat on the ground, a white shine highlight on top, two big round black eyes with white highlights and a small open hungry mouth on the left side of the body. No arms, no legs.

slime_helmet.name: 투구 슬라임
slime_helmet.description: EXACTLY the same green slime as the attached slime image (same shape, size, colors, face, pose, facing LEFT), now wearing an oversized brown acorn cap as a helmet on top, tilted slightly, with a little stem on top. Change nothing else.

wisp.name: 도깨비불
wisp.description: A small floating purple will-o'-the-wisp spirit monster, cute and mischievous. Side 3/4 view facing LEFT. A rounded teardrop flame-shaped body of glowing lavender-purple with a lighter core, two big eyes and a small grin on the left side, and a wispy flame tail trailing up and to the RIGHT. It floats above the ground (no legs).

hedgehog.name: 고슴도치
hedgehog.description: A round chubby hedgehog, the spiky wall that hurts monsters who bite it. Side 3/4 view facing RIGHT, standing on short little legs. A big dome of brown-and-cream spines covering the back like a chestnut burr, a soft beige face and belly, tiny pink nose, determined but cute eyes with a white highlight. The spine dome is clearly separated from the face and feet.

owl.name: 부엉이
owl.description: A fluffy round barn owl, the magic support that slows monsters. Standing upright on a small stump-free pose, side 3/4 view facing RIGHT. Soft caramel-and-cream feathers, a heart-shaped pale face, huge round amber eyes with white highlights, small beak, both wings folded at the sides and clearly separated from the body outline, little ear tufts.

bear.name: 곰
bear.description: A sturdy brown bear cub, the heavy hitter that swipes monsters right in front of it. Standing upright, side 3/4 view facing RIGHT, one big front paw raised high ready to swipe (clearly separated from the body), other paw on the belly. Warm brown fur, lighter tan muzzle and belly, small round ears, brave eyes with a white highlight.

golem.name: 돌 골렘
golem.description: A chunky stone golem monster, cute not scary, very slow and very tough. Side 3/4 view facing LEFT. Body made of rounded grey boulders with green moss patches, two short thick stone legs, two big stone fists, small glowing teal eyes and a tiny grumpy mouth on the left side. Arms and legs clearly separated from the body.

bat.name: 박쥐
bat.description: A small purple bat monster flying, cute and sneaky. Side 3/4 view facing LEFT, both wings spread wide open (clearly separated from the round body), big pointy ears, big mischievous eyes, a tiny fang. Floating in the air, no ground.

mushroom.name: 버섯 포자
mushroom.description: A walking mushroom monster, cute. Side 3/4 view facing LEFT. A big round red cap with white spots, a cream stem body with a small face (two dot eyes and a little mouth) on the left side, two tiny feet. The cap is clearly separated from the stem.

boss_slime.name: 거대 슬라임
boss_slime.description: EXACTLY the same green slime as the attached slime image (same shape, colors, glossy style, facing LEFT), but now it is the KING: wearing a small golden crown tilted on top, with slightly angry eyebrows and a bigger grin. Change nothing else.

idle.prompt: Idle breathing loop: body gently rises and falls, tail sways slowly, one ear twitches once. Frame 8 must flow back into frame 1.

attack.prompt: Throw attack: crouch back to anticipate (frames 1-3), lunge forward with front paws flinging a small orange-gold fox-fire flame to the RIGHT (frame 5 is the release, the flame just leaving the paws), then settle back to the idle pose (frames 6-8).

hit.prompt: Hurt reaction: flinch backward to the LEFT with squinted eyes and flattened ears (frames 1-2), then recover to the idle pose (frames 3-4).

death.prompt: Defeat: wobble, dizzy swirl eyes, slowly tip over onto its side and lie still with the tail flopping down. No blood, cute and gentle.

props._설명: 정지 그림 (효과·배경). python tools/gen_art.py prop <이름> → art/ref/props/<이름>.png. 게임에서 코드로 돌리기·크기·투명도를 바꿔 움직인다. size = assets/images/fx/에 저장할 크기 (prep_props.py). background.flatten_rows = 줄무늬를 지울 잔디 영역 [x0, x1, y0, y1] (비율). 원본 잔디에 줄무늬가 7개라 레인 5개와 안 맞아서 지우고 게임이 레인 체크무늬를 그린다 (WORKLOG 3-g). ref가 있으면 그 그림을 참고 그림으로 넣는다 (밤 배경은 낮 배경을 넣어 구도를 그대로 따르게).

acorn.prompt: A single shiny cartoon acorn, the collectible currency of the game. Brown scaly cap with a tiny stem, glossy golden-brown nut with a bright highlight, slightly tilted, centered. A small soft sparkle star near the top. Readable at 48px.

log.prompt: A round wooden log seen exactly END-ON (we see the circular cut face, like a wheel): light wood face with clear concentric growth rings and a few radial cracks, a thick dark-brown bark rim all around, one small leaf sprouting from the bark. Perfectly round and centered so it can be rotated to look like rolling.

smoke.prompt: A cute cartoon smoke puff cloud for a defeat/explosion effect: a cluster of 5-6 round fluffy puffs, soft warm white-gray with light lavender shading, thick dark-brown outline, a few tiny round puffs around it, a couple of small yellow-white stars. Centered.

background.prompt:
Game background for a cozy cartoon forest lane-defense game, 16:9 landscape, flat front view like Plants vs. Zombies (no strong perspective). Same art style as the attached character (thick dark-brown outlines on big shapes, soft cel shading, bright warm palette). Layout, strictly:
- TOP 15% of the height: a dense band of leafy tree canopy and branches across the whole width (game UI will be drawn over it).
- LEFT 11% of the width, below the canopy: a cozy animal home: big tree trunk roots with a round burrow door, moss and small mushrooms.
- CENTER (from 11% to 81% of the width, from 15% to 92% of the height): one open flat lawn of short bright grass with very gentle horizontal stripes, EMPTY - no flowers, rocks or objects on it, because a 9x5 grid of tiles is drawn on top by the game.
- RIGHT 19% of the width: a winding dirt path coming out of darker, slightly mysterious woods, where monsters will enter.
- BOTTOM 8%: a strip of mossy ground with roots and pebbles.
No characters, no text, no UI.

shovel.prompt: A small cartoon garden shovel icon, tilted 45 degrees with the blade at the bottom-left: shiny steel-gray blade with a soft highlight, short warm wooden handle with a rounded grip. Centered, bold and readable at 48px.

background_night.prompt: The attached image is the DAY version of this game background. Redraw EXACTLY the same scene and layout (same tree on the left with the round burrow door, same canopy band on top, same open lawn in the center with no objects, same winding dirt path on the right, same mossy root strip at the bottom) but at NIGHT: deep blue and teal moonlit colors, a soft moon glow from the top right, a warm glowing lantern hanging by the burrow door, a few small glowing fireflies only in the canopy and the path area (none on the lawn), the lawn darker blue-green but still clearly readable. Same art style, thick outlines. No characters, no text, no UI.
